subject: porous Pt layer (0.08 C cm-2 deposition)
source_sentence: The E j10 value of the porous Pt layers electrodeposited with 0.08 C cm −2 is 1.76 V, corresponding to a 140 mV lower overpotential for OER than that of a bare Pt electrode.
